senses.gloss:
अमोक्य अ-मोक्य, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. मुच्), Ved.
that cannot be unloosed.

अ-मोचन, अम्, n. not loosening or letting go;
non-liberation.

आ-मोचन, अम्, n. the act of loosing, liberating;
emitting, shedding, letting forth, putting or tying on.

अ-मोचनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, not to be liberated, not
to be let go.
अ-मोचित, अस्, आ, अम्, not liberated, confined.

अमोक्ष अ-मोक्ष, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. मोक्ष्),
unliberated, unloosed; (अस्), m. want of freedom,
bondage, confinement; non-liberation from mundane
existence.

अमोघ अ-मोघ, अस्, आ, अम्, unerring, un-
failing, not vain, efficacious, succeeding, reaching the
mark; productive, fruitful; (अस्), m. the not erring,
the not failing; unerringness; N. of Śiva and Viṣṇu;
N. of a river; (आ), f. trumpet flower, Bignonia
Suaveolens, Roxb: a plant of which the seed is
used as a vermifuge, Erycibe Paniculata, Roxb.; Ter-
minalia Citrina, Roxb.; N. of a spear; N. of Śiva's
wife; mystical name of the double consonant क्ष्.
—अमोघ-दण्ड, अस्, m. (unerring in punish-
ment), N. of Śiva.
—अमोघ-दर्शिन्, ई, m., N. of
a Bodhi-sattva.
—अमोघ-दृष्टि, इस्, इस्, इ, of un-
erring view or mind.
—अमोघ-बल, अस्, आ, अम्, of
never-failing strength.
—अमोघ-भूति, इस्, m., N. of
a king of the Pañjāb.
—अमोघ-राज, अस्, m., N. of
a Bhikṣu.
—अमोघ-वाच्, क्, f. words that are not
vain or idle.
—अमोघ-वाञ्छित, अस्, आ, अम्, never
disappointed.
—अमोघ-विक्रम, अस्, m. of un-
erring valour; N. of Śiva.
—अमोघ-सिद्ध, अस्,
m., N. of the fifth Dhyāni-buddha.
—अमोघाचार्य
(˚घ-आच्˚), अस्, m., N. of an author.

अमोत अमोत (अमा-उत), अस्, आ, अम्, Ved.
woven at home, taken care of at home; see 2. अमा.
—अमोत-पुत्रका, f., Ved. a maiden protected at
home.

अमोतक, अस्, m., Ved. protected at home (a
child); a weaver (?).

आमोक्षण आ-मोक्षण, अम्, n. the act of
fixing or tying on or to.

आमोद आ-मोद, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. मुद् with
आ), gladdening, cheering up; (अस्), m. joy, serenity,
pleasure; fragrancy, a diffusive perfume; strong smell.
आ-मोदित, अस्, आ, अम्, pleased, delighted, fragrant.

आमोष आ-मोष, अस्, m. (fr. rt. मुष् with
आ), robbing, stealing.
आ-मोषिन्, ई, इणी, इ, who or what steals, a thief.

आमोहनिका आ-मोहनिका, f. (fr. rt. मुह् with
आ), a particular fragrant odour.
